WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        category,
        COUNT(*) as line_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN (spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_relative_overspend
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
avg_line_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(line_count AS FLOAT)) as overall_avg
    FROM category_stats
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT cs.avg_relative_overspend, cs.line_count, alc.overall_avg
    FROM category_stats cs
    CROSS JOIN avg_line_count alc
    WHERE cs.line_count > alc.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) as summary_avg_overspend,
    AVG(CAST(line_count AS FLOAT)) as summary_avg_line_count,
    AVG(CAST(line_count AS FLOAT) - overall_avg) as summary_avg_excess
FROM filtered
